translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: Hebru
book.title: Hebru Maktumne taat ŋu siirtu ɗo gee ku Hebru

content: Ka seener, ay mee satkiner ka tatko, ŋu doɓig min ɗatik ta geemir a ŋaa gine riy ta Buŋdi ɗo bi kan̰co. Riy-at, ŋaa iye gamin ku berindi ɗo Buŋdi ho ŋaaji gine satkine ɗo bi ka zunuubinna ku geemir.
Gay satkiner-ak nec tale amindaw ta ŋuur kuuk ibanno maanna ho jagaw, asaan ŋaar meen̰ji oki aawaat gudurrey sooɗa ɗo gamin dakina.
Ɗo saan ta gudurrey taat sooɗ-ata, illa ŋaa ginen̰ ja *satkin ɗo zunuubinna ku meen̰ji, kar kat ɗo ku geemir.
Waan gediraaɗo darjiye ziy a ŋa mee satkiner ka tatko. Illa Buŋ kat kola gemo a ŋaa gine riy-ata ar awalle, ŋa koliig *Haruun.
Iisa Masi oki, ŋa meen̰jiɗo kat darjiy ziy a ŋa *mee satkiner ka tatko. Kar gay, ŋa Buŋ kat darjiyga, wiktin taat ŋa ɗiyiiji aman :

content.text: min ƴiriyta-aŋ, ŋuu ibine kadar nun ko takko. »

content: Ɗo wer ka pey, ŋu siir ɗo Kitamner aman :

content.text: « Kiŋ gay satkiner kaak goy doo ar Melkisedek. »

content: Wiktin taat Iisa goytu ɗo duniiner, ŋa inditu Buŋ ho ŋa loklikiiji iŋ koriya ho iŋ zulan̰ oki. Ŋa indiig ŋaar kaak nec jilin̰ min ɗo muuti ho ɗo bi ka karaamin taat ŋa karmiyiig Buŋ, Buŋ cokiyiig alin̰ji.
Ŋa Roŋ ka Buŋdi. Kar iŋ taar-ata oki, ŋa ɓilde karaamin iŋ botol ta taaɓiner.
Iŋ goyin̰ji, wiktin taat ŋa nectu ko tak ar kaak Buŋ rakiyo, ŋa piltu botol a gee okin̰co kuuk icit kaawoy yaa gase jile kaak goy doo.
Buŋ diyig mee satkiner ka tatko ar kaak ŋa diyig Melkisedek-aka.
Ɗo bi ŋaar-aŋ, ni gin kaawin dakina kuuk niiko kaawe. Kar gay, gaarin̰co yaa gine raɗa, asaan diŋ, kaƴko icɗo koɗok.
Wiktin-an nec ko zer kuu garkiye gee. Kar sando, illa ŋuuko garkiyiŋko pey iŋ gamin ku melen̰ ɗo bi ka kaaw ta Buŋdi. Kuŋko-aŋ ar koogin kuuk siya misa buwa, yampa, ande, ku gediraaɗo teen̰ji.
Ŋaar kaak siya buwa-ak, ŋaar ar mic kaak ibanno misa maan kaak samaane iŋ kaak samaanno.
Kar ande gay, ŋaar ɗo gee kuuk aginda kuuk usin ko eerin̰ gamin kuuk samaane iŋ kuuk samaanno, asaan taar ko taat ŋu gingiy ɗo goyin̰co.

footnotes.text: Wer ka gase kaawor ɗo Soom 2.7.
